name: A2C 合同委托
description: 把用户需求的一部分按合同委托给专业服务智能体：取合同模板、拟合同卡、签字、交材料、取件、验收、付款与解除。

display_description.zh: 接入 A2C（Agent 2 Contract）委托方 SDK：与专业服务智能体就尚未做出来的劳动成果签合同，分期交付、按服务方提供的验收器验收、经支付方按卡付款。签字与付款前都会请你确认。
display_description.en: Connect the A2C (Agent 2 Contract) client SDK: contract professional service agents for work not yet done, accept each period with the provider's verifiers and pay through a licensed payment provider. Every signature and payment asks for your confirmation.
